manifesto.p1: Social connection is one of the most essential parts of life. It helps people <pill>connect</pill>, communicate, and <sticker-yellow>find those who truly fit</sticker-yellow>.
manifesto.p2: Yet these precious connections are being replaced by <sticker-orange>labels and algorithms</sticker-orange>, plus the constant stream of notifications on a screen.
manifesto.p3: From the PC forum era to Mobile swipe-based social, platforms have spent decades building complex matching and recommendation systems. But people have not become closer; instead, they feel farther apart.
manifesto.p4: Because meeting should happen at the right time, in the <pill>right setting</pill>, and with the <sticker-orange>right person</sticker-orange>.
manifesto.transition: It's time to enter AI Native

problem.title: Social shouldn't be this hard

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell AI who you are, what you enjoy, what you like doing, and who you want to meet.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Get matched with people who fit, then let AI help start the conversation and arrange activities that suit you both.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Meet through an activity you choose together or one the system recommends.
